mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in both residential investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening supply conditions and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS > 4% during late-cycle expansion.
